correctness.rationale: Proof reconstructs the exact Schur complement via Sherman–Morrison for every real unit spike eigenvector and every positive a,b. The resulting trace error strictly decreases with selected spike mass; top-k averaging with strict equality cases characterizes all maximizing orientations. Direct elementary symmetric polynomial calculation gives the same DPP expectation. An independent rational Gaussian elimination checker passes 2,586 finite equalities, used only as a reproducibility test.
